assessment.summary: Beta.105 source-impact review: official releases, tag refs and five-commit comparisons identify Aquarea 1.9.0 at d3867f4143f7e2c15b84ed67c6e7ace2561f5f96 and aioaquarea-ng 1.5.0 at 55da9428ddf43ed26f2386d79c43d50cf4d9da0c. Integration setup/config/coordinator now distinguish app-version rejection, create a repair and retry instead of wrong-password reauthentication; failed polls remain UpdateFailed. SDK auth probes and caches accepted app versions, bounds the rejected-login retry and adds a specific AuthenticationError subtype, safe error-code logging and a credential-free canary. Examined changes do not alter the device/zone/tank/status parsers consumed by SolarPilot. SolarPilot performs no provider login or probe and already rejects failed coordinator updates and stale/unknown contract evidence. No additional production change is needed; do not suppress repairs or convert cached values to fresh physical evidence or OFF. Previous monthly-period and typed status review remains applicable. Source freshness is not runtime compatibility, installation acceptance or physical sensor validation. All exact-commit regression, browser, startup and publication gates remain required, with no claimed outcome in this record.
